 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Jayden Daniels is gearing up for his biggest challenge yet just weeks into the 2026 season. Daniels will help lead the Washington Commanders against an undefeated team in the league in the San Francisco 49ers at Levi's Stadium.
 The 25-year-old quarterback is coming off a tough 27-27 overtime tie against the New York Giants, where he threw for 199 yards, but it was his run game that helped him earn a spot among an NFL elite.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He finished the game with 103 rushing yards with two rushing touchdowns, becoming the first quarterback with multiple 25-plus yard rushing touchdowns in the same game since Michael Vick in 2002.
 It was Daniels' first game back after dislocating his elbow in Week 2 against the Dallas Cowboys. The 2026 season will be another season where Daniels fails to play a full season, not having done so since 2024, when he played in 17 games, winning the AP Offensive Rookie of the Year award.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In three games this season, Daniels has thrown for 459 yards with three touchdowns and 25 first downs and holds a 90.8 passer rating, according to Pro Football Reference. He also has 203 rushing yards with two rushing touchdowns.
 Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels (5) runs for a touchdown.Geoff Burke-Imagn Images
 Now, Daniels will try to maintain his momentum against the 49ers, who are the league's hottest team at 5-0, and try to earn his first win of the season. If Daniels can keep up the run game to stress the 49ers rushing lanes, he will give the Commanders a chance to win in Santa Clara.
